title: Use-case seed candidate primitive
purpose: Store a broad use-case seed as a candidate primitive before promotion into tools, pipelines, rubrics, or knowledge packs.
privacy_rule: Use synthetic seed descriptions only; no customer prompts or private source data.

title: Flexible hierarchy label assignment
purpose: Represent verticals, workflows, jurisdictions, and domains without changing core capability or modality vocabularies.
privacy_rule: Generated labels need review before deployment routing.

title: Use-case seed risk and complexity dimensions
purpose: Attach sortable/filterable features such as risk score, stage count, input count, output count, human-review need, and excluded scopes.
privacy_rule: Dimensions are deterministic or generated candidates until reviewed.

title: Insurance exclusion label
purpose: Mark seed-derived records as excluding insurance scope so search and promotion can filter them out.
privacy_rule: Do not create new insurance pipeline seeds in this batch.

title: High-risk use-case seed review ticket
purpose: Route high-risk legal, moderation, animal care, oil and gas, geographic, or banking-law seeds to curator review before promotion.
privacy_rule: Ticket reasons should not contain private source material.

title: Use-case seed entity reference
purpose: Connect candidate primitives to graph-addressable entities for domains, labels, label ancestors, inputs, outputs, stages, and risk tiers.
privacy_rule: Use canonical entity IDs and generic metadata, not private raw mentions.

title: Use-case seed object embedding stub
purpose: Store deterministic embedding text, text hash, and embedding bucket for later real embedding backfill and low-cost comparison blocking.
privacy_rule: Use synthetic seed metadata only; the stub vector remains blank until an embedding worker runs.
